newsitem.title: USA: Cotton Council to bar media from Tennessee meeting.
newsitem.headline: Cotton Council to bar media from Tennessee meeting.

text.p: The National Cotton Council of America (NCC) has decided to close its autumn Producer Steering Committee meeting to the media, NCC officials said.

The meeting, which is slated to begin Wednesday in Memphis, Tennessee, and will feature a speech by leading cotton merchant William Dunavant, will be open only to industry members, the NCC said in a statement.

"Due to the current market sitaution, it is important that there be detailed discussion of the issues at hand," the statement said. NCC officials contacted in Memphis declined to elaborate on the statement.

The NCC said it will make available to the media any recommendations developed by the NCC's Board of Directors. In addition, the NCC scheduled a news conference with industry leaders following the Wednesday steering committee meeting.
-- Wendy Pollack, New York Commodities Desk +1 212 859 1640
